title: Law.com International features Burford's Patrick Savage on law firm talent retention
summary: Law.com International features Burford's Patrick Savage on law firm talent retention. Learn more.
body_markdown:
An article in *Law.com International* explores how private capital and long-term equity incentives could help law firms retain top talent. Burford's[Patrick Savage](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/patrick-savage/) is featured, noting that traditional partnership remuneration models “\[don't\] lend \[themselves\] to retention” and offer little incentive for partners to remain with a firm over multiple years.


Read the full article[here](https://www.law.com/international-edition/2026/11/19/golden-handcuffs-could-private-capital-solve-big-laws-retention-dilemma-/) .
